verdict.rationale: Ironclad's store-contracts product page is headlined "Store Contracts Securely, Find Them Easily," which points to a searchable repository. The Records API lets you create, retrieve and update contract records, and integrations can read and write structured data. Automated extraction of key terms and metadata is only implied by a "Contract Intelligence" page title and is never described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI or automated key-term and metadata extraction, details of repository search and filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the repository experience.
